title: Ziyarat e Aale Yasin
introduction:
ZIYARAT E AALE YASEEN

You may then come down to the holy vault and visit Imam al-Mahdi (‘a) with the forumula of ziyarah that is reported from him according to the report of the sublime Shaykh Ahmad ibn Abi-Talib al-Tabrisi in his book of al-Ihtijaj, as follows:

The following document was issued from the Sacred Side after replying to some questions:

When you intend to turn your faces towards Allah and towards us by means of us, you should say just as Allah the All-exalted has said:

SUPPLICATION FOLLOWING ZIYARAT E AALE YASEEN

verses.translation: In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
You neither understand His decree
nor accept from His Vicegerents.
(This is) consummate wisdom; but warnings do not avail
people who do not believe.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلٰى عِبَادِ اللّٰهِ الصَّالِحِيْنَ
verses.translation: Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.
Peace be upon the Household of Yasin.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا دَاعِيَ اللّٰهِ وَ رَبَّانِيَّ اٰيَاتِهِ،
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O caller to Allah and interpreter of His Verses.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَابَ اللّٰهِ وَ دَيَّانَ دِيْنِهِ،
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O door to Allah and applier of His religion.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَلِيْفَةَ اللّٰهِ وَ نَاصِرَ حَقِّهِ،
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O viceroy of Allah and backer of His right.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ اللّٰهِ وَ دَلِيْلَ اِرَادَتِهِ،
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O Argument of Allah and sign of His volition.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا تَالِيَ كِتَابِ اللّٰهِ وَ تَرْجُمَانَهُ،
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O reciter of the Book of Allah and its interpreter.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ فِيۤ اٰنَاۤءِ لَيْلِكَ وَ اَطْرَافِ نَهَارِكَ،
verses.translation: Peace be upon you at the hours of Your night and the two ends of Your day.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَقِيَّةَ اللّٰهِ فِيْ اَرْضِهِ،
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O herald of Allah on His lands.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مِيْثَاقَ اللّٰهِ، الَّذِيْ اَخَذَهُ وَ وَكَّدَهُ.
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O covenant of Allah that He has made and confirmed.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ، الَّذِيْ ضَمِنَهُ.
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O Promise of Allah that He has assured.
Peace be upon you, O appointed pennon,
poured knowledge,
aid, and expansive mercy.
This is verily a promise that shall never be belied.
Peace be upon you whenever you rise (to undertake the mission).
Peace be upon you whenever you sit.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ حِيْنَ تَقْرَاُ وَ تُبَيِّنُ.
verses.translation: Peace be upon you whenever you recite and elucidate.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ حِيْنَ تُصَلِّيْ وَ تَقْنُتُ.
verses.translation: Peace be upon you whenever you offer prayer and supplicate.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ حِيْنَ تَرْكَعُ وَ تَسْجُدُ.
verses.translation: Peace be upon you whenever you genuflect and prostrate (yourself for Allah).

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ حِيْنَ تُهَلِّلُ وَ تُكَبِّرُ.
verses.translation: Peace be upon you whenever you profess Allah’s Godhead and profess His All-greatness.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ حِيْنَ تَحْمَدُ وَ تَسْتَغْفِرُ.
verses.translation: Peace be upon you whenever you praise Allah and implore for His forgiveness.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ حِيْنَ تُصْبِحُ وَ تُمْسِيۤ.
verses.translation: Peace be upon you whenever you begin and end your day.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ فِي اللَّيْلِ اِذَا يَغْشٰى،
verses.translation: Peace be upon you in the night when it draws a veil
and the day when it shines in brightness.
Peace be upon you, O entrusted leader.
Peace be upon you, O favored and expected.
Peace be upon you to the ultimate meaning of peace.
I solicit you, O my master,

verses.arabic: اَنِّيۤ اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ،
verses.translation: to testify to me that I bear witness that there is no god but Allah؛
One and Only Lord and having no associate,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُوْلُهُ،
verses.translation: and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

verses.arabic: لَا حَبِيْبَ اِلَّا هُوَ وَ اَهْلُهُ،
verses.translation: There is no one more beloved by Allah than him and his household.
And I solicit you, O my master, to testify to me that I bear witness
that 'Ali the Commander of the Faithful is His argument,
al-Hasan is His argument,
al-Husayn is His argument,
'Ali the son of al-Husayn is His argument,
Muhammad the son of 'Ali is His argument,
Ja'far the son of Muhammad is His argument,
Musa the son of Ja'far is His argument,
'Ali the son of Musa is His argument,
Muhammad the son of 'Ali is His argument,
'Ali the son of Muhammad is His argument,
and al-Hasan the son of 'Ali is His argument.
I also bear witness that you are verily the argument of Allah.
You all are the first and the last.

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَّ رَجْعَتَكُمْ حَقٌّ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهَا،
verses.translation: And (I bear witness) that your (promised) Return is undoubtedly true
"On the day when its belief avails not a soul
which theretofore believed not,
nor in its belief earned good by works,"
death is true,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَّ نَاكِرًا وَ نَكِيْرًا حَقٌّ،
verses.translation: and Naakir and Nakir are true.
And I bear witness that the Raising for death is true,
the Resurrection is true,
the Discriminating Bridge is true,
the Watchtower is true,
the Balance (of deeds) is true,
the Gathering is true,
the Reckoning is true.
Paradise and Hell are true,

verses.arabic: وَ الْوَعْدَ وَ الْوَعِيْدَ بِهِمَا حَقٌّ.
verses.translation: and the promise of Paradise and the threat with Hell are true.
O My master! Certainly wretched is he who opposes you
and certainly happy is he who obeys you.
So, testify to me all that which I have besought you to testify.
I am verily an ally of you
and denouncing your enemy.
The truth is only that which you accept,
the wrong is only that which you disallow,
the good is only that which you enjoin,
and the evil is only that which you forbid.
My soul is thus believing in Allah;
One and Only Lord and having no associate,
and also in His Messenger, in the Commander of the Faithful,

verses.arabic: وَ بِكُمْ يَا مَوْلَايَ، اَوَّلِكُمْ وَ اٰخِرِكُمْ،
verses.translation: and in you all, O my master, from the beginning to the end.
I have prepared myself to back you
and my love is sincerely dedicated to you.
Respond! Respond!

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيۤ اَسْاَلُكَ، اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: O Allah, I beseech You to send blessings upon Muhammad
the Prophet of Your mercy and the Word of Your Light,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْ تَمْلَاَ قَلْبِيْ نُورَ الْيَقِيْنِ،
verses.translation: and to fill in my heart with the illumination of certitude,
my chest with the illumination of faith,
my intellect with the illumination of honest intentions,
my determination with the illumination of knowledge,
my strength with the illumination of work,
my tongue with the illumination of honesty,

verses.arabic: وَ دِيْنِيْ نُوْرَ الْبَصَاۤئِرِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ،
verses.translation: my religion with the illumination of clear evidence from You,
my sight with the illumination of brightness,
my hearing with the illumination of wisdom,

verses.arabic: وَ مَوَدَّتِيْ نُوْرَ الْمُوَالَاةِ لِمُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ
verses.translation: and my faculty of love with the illumination of sincere loyalty to Muhammad and his Household,
peace be upon them,

verses.arabic: حَتّٰىۤ اَلْقَاكَ وَ قَدْ وَفَيْتُ بِعَهْدِكَ وَ مِيْثَاقِكَ،
verses.translation: so that I, when I meet You, will have fulfilled the pledge and covenant that I made with You
and then Your mercy will encompass me.
O Protector! O Worthy of all praise!
O Allah, bless Muhammad (al-Mahdi)
Your argument in Your land.
Your viceroy in Your countries,
the caller to Your course,
the establisher of Your justice,
the revolting by Your command,
the authority of the believers,
the ruiner of the unbelievers,
the remover of the murk,
the illuminator of the truth,
the speaker with wisdom and honesty,
the perfect Word of You in Your lands,
the vigilant and fearful,
the well-wishing saint,
the ark of salvation,
the sign of guidance,
the light of the peoples' sights,

verses.arabic: وَ خَيْرِ مَنْ تَقَمَّصَ وَ ارْتَدٰى،
verses.translation: the best of all those who put clothes on their bodies,
and the unveiler of blindness,

verses.arabic: اَلَّذِيْ يَمْلَاُ الْاَرْضَ عَدْلًا وَ قِسْطًا،
verses.translation: who will fill the lands with justice and equity
as it would be filled up with wrong and unfairness.
You verily have power over all things.
O Allah, bless Your vicegerent

verses.arabic: وَ ابْنِ اَوْلِيَاۤئِكَ، الَّذِيْنَ فَرَضْتَ طَاعَتَهُمْ،
verses.translation: and the son of Your vicegerents the obedience to whom You have made incumbent upon us
and the observance of the right of whom You have made obligatory
and from whom You have removed filth
and whom You have purified with thorough purifying.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ انْصُرْهُ وَ انْتَصِرْ بِهِ لِدِيْنِكَ،
verses.translation: O Allah, give him victory and make him the supporter of Your religion

verses.arabic: وَ انْصُرْ بِهِ اَوْلِيَاۤءَكَ، وَ اَوْلِيَاۤءَهُ
verses.translation: and through him, give victory to Your and his adherents,
followers, and backers.
Include us with them.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعِذْهُ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ بَاغٍ وَ طَاغٍ،
verses.translation: O Allah, protect him against the evil of every transgressor and tyrant
and against the evils of all Your creatures.

verses.arabic: وَ احْفَظْهُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِ
verses.translation: Guard him from ahead of him, behind him,

verses.arabic: وَ عَنْ يَمِيْنِهِ وَ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ،
verses.translation: his right side, and his left side.

verses.arabic: وَ احْرُسْهُ وَ امْنَعْهُ مِنْ اَنْ يُوْصَلَ اِلَيْهِ بِسُوۤءٍ،
verses.translation: Watch him and defend him against anything that may cause evil to him.

verses.arabic: وَ احْفَظْ فِيْهِ رَسُوْلَكَ وَ اٰلَ رَسُوْلِكَ،
verses.translation: Save through him Your Messenger and the family of Your Messenger.
Manifest justice through him.
Aid him with victory.
Help his backers.
Frustrate those who intend to disappoint him.
Terminate those who intend to eradicate him.
And, through him, terminate the tyrants of unbelief,

verses.arabic: وَ اقْتُلْ بِهِ الْكُفَّارَ وَ الْمُنَافِقِيْنَ
verses.translation: kill the disbelievers, the hypocrites,
and all atheists,

verses.arabic: حَيْثُ كَانُوْا مِنْ مَشَارِقِ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبِهَا،
verses.translation: wherever they are; in the east or the west of the earth
on the lands or in the oceans,
and, through him, fill in the earth with justice,
manifest the religion of Your Prophet,
blessings and peace of You be upon him and his Household,

verses.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْنِيْ اللّٰهُمَّ مِنْ اَنْصَارِهِ وَ اَعْوَانِهِ
verses.translation: make me, O Allah, of his supporters, helpers,
followers, and adherents;

verses.arabic: وَ اَرِنِيْ فِيۤ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ مَا يَأْمُلُوْنَ،
verses.translation: allow me to see the hopes of the family of Muhammad, peace be upon them, come true,
and the hazards of their enemies come true.
O God of Truth, respond.
O Lord of Glory and Honor!
O most merciful of those who show mercy!
